podcast.title: Signed Owl City (2009)
podcast.body: Universal Republic signed Christian electro-pop artist Adam Young, known as Owl City, in 2009. The label viewed Owl City as "representing the future of our business," particularly due to Young's active curation of his Myspace profile, which fostered a direct connection with his fanbase online. "led to his signing with major label Universal Republic."

podcast.title: David Botrell's Work in NYC
podcast.body: David Botrell moved to New York City to work on projects specifically with Universal Republic. This move also enabled him to fulfill a personal dream of living in the city. "I went to do work on some projects in New York City with Universal Republic"
